question: Electron microscopic studies of eukaryotic cells reveal the presence of a network of tiny tubular structures scattered in the cytoplasm that is called the ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Endoplasmic Reticulum.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Electron microscopic studies of eukaryotic cells reveal the presence of a network of tiny tubular structures scattered in the cytoplasm that is called the **Endoplasmic Reticulum.**
 
• The variants of the endoplasmic reticulum are following
 
 
• Rough ER
 
• Smooth ER
 
 
 
• The Rough ER has ribosomes embedded within its structure, giving a 'rough' appearance.
 
• The smooth ER does not have these ribosomes, hence appears 'smooth.'
 
• The smooth endoplasmic reticulum is responsible for the synthesis of essential lipids such as cholesterol and phospholipids.
 
• The majority of the functions of the rough endoplasmic reticulum are associated with protein synthesis.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Golgi apparatus has multiple names such as Golgi complex or Golgi body.

 
 
• It is found in all eukaryotic cells, plants as well as animals.
 
• They are membrane-bound organelle present in the cytosol of the cell. 
 
 
 
• Peroxisomes
 
 
• It is a microbody.
 
• In-plant it helps in photorespiration. In animals concerned with peroxide metabolism.
 
 
 
• ​Mitochondria is a double-layered cell organelle, in which the outer layer is porous and the inner layer is folded upon itself is known to be cristae.
 
 
• The number of mitochondria in a single cell may be up to 50 to 5000.
 
• The inner lumen of mitochondria contains ribosome phosphate particles and DNA molecules.
 
• It has the potential to synthesize its own protein and oxidation of carbohydrates and fats are taken place with the help of enzymes in mitochondria.
 
• This energy is stored in the form of ATP ( Adenosine Triphosphate ) so, these are known as the "Powerhouse of the cell".
